findings.description: Directly inspected all eleven fresh V162 renders. The overskirt remains severely crumpled with irregular sharp folds and a lumpy hem; the authored pleat silhouette is not preserved, and the back/side views show the skirt lifting to expose much of the shorts.

Crouch, sit, prone and arm-cross renders still read as upright or otherwise fail to show the named pose. Cloth evidence records an actual five-frame animated body/waist-pin cache and distinct body hashes, but current renders are the neutral end shape followed by the separate skinning path; they do not show cache-frame drape or collision safety.
Fresh renders show sleeves detached or hanging away from the arms in some views, together with gray/pinched lower-jacket patches and an uneven jacket-to-waistband transition.

nextAction: Keep V162 rejected and prototype-only. Before any more shape tuning, directly render cloth-cache frames 1, 16, 32, 40 and 48 with the corresponding evaluated avatar and garment together. Inspect why the normal pose-render path leaves crouch, sit, prone and arm-cross looking upright or invalid; fix cache/bind/rest-pose or pose-ordering only after locating the cause. Reassess the skirt pleat collapse, back coverage, sleeve placement and torso patches from those renders. Fit, collision safety, weights, complete UVs, Shape Key response, Unity/VRChat execution, packaging and release remain unverified.
